P01.rationale: No dominant founder/person portrait is present; the page uses only small group reference photos at the bottom with no single large human anchor.

P05.rationale: There are no named client portraits framed at meaningful size in case study sections; the bottom photos are small, unlabeled group shots.

P07.rationale: A minimal 'Bekannt aus' section lists three client names with underlines but lacks logos, rating cards, or a proper press/logo wall apparatus.

P10.rationale: No oversized decorative typographic elements such as giant ghost numerals or large quote glyphs are present anywhere on the page.

P11.rationale: The right column presents real numeric stats (100+, €200k+, 30–50%) with labels and a bulleted before/after list, functioning as a basic data-bound proof panel.

P12.rationale: The page has a reasonable amount of text but the bottom third is sparse with small photos and a thin client-name strip, leaving the layout feeling under-filled compared to magazine-quality density.

P13.rationale: The background is entirely flat white with no texture, atmosphere, or tonal treatment applied anywhere on the page.

P14.rationale: The three reference photos at the bottom have no text overlaid on them, so scrim treatment is not needed, but no full-bleed photo is used either.

P16.rationale: No device or product mockup (phone, laptop, book) appears anywhere on the page.

N07.rationale: The three bottom photos appear to be real business/event shots rather than pure stock, but they are small and contextually ambiguous, giving a moderately generic impression.

N08.rationale: The lower portion of the page—particularly the 'Bekannt aus' strip and the gap around the reference photos—contains significant purposeless dead whitespace.

N10.rationale: No text is placed directly over a busy photo without a scrim; text and images are kept in separate zones throughout.
